about: Blind labels of the 100 test comments by a language model from a provider other than the ones the system uses: three independent readings (A, B, C) of the blind sheet with neutral ids; themes, sentiment, the critical flag and the critical types by majority vote (2 of 3); the doubt flag when any reading had a doubt; one more reading only for comments without a majority (none needed it). Not human labels. See docs/evaluation.md.
